english.title: Keeper of animals kept holding register in a form other than approved by the Welsh Ministers (Wales)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a keeper of animals of the ovine or caprine species, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..), who was required to keep a register in accordance with Council Regulation (EC) No21/2004, kept a holding register that was not in a form approved by the Welsh Ministers in that **(..SPECIFY DISCREPANCY IN FORM..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 23(5) of the Sheep and Goats (Records, Identification and Movement) (Wales) Order 2015 and sections 73 and 75 Animal Health Act 1981.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant, being a keeper of animals of the ovine or caprine species, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..), who was required to keep a register in accordance with Council Regulation (EC) No21/2004, kept a holding register that was not in a form approved by the Welsh Ministers in that **(..SPECIFY DISCREPANCY IN FORM..).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale. Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
